race.comment: PRESTIGE ZERPRISE (5) has found some form recently and was a bold third at Wangaratta just over 2 weeks ago. Ben Allen is riding well and picks up the ride, and the pair merits healthy respect. MASAKARI (4) finished just behind the second pick in the same race last start, and he may have found the 7-day backup too much to handle. He is good enough to win a maiden, so follow your money. MEDIA BRIEF (9) failed to cope with the heavy track at Wodonga 3 weeks ago after a bold effort for second fresh up at Gundagai before that. She can make amends in this. DEADLY DEVIL (3) will be backing up quickly after finishing sixth at Wodonga 6-days ago. The extra 150m will suit him, and he can figure in the top 4 here. STYLE GUIDE (11) strips fitter, and is the best of the rest.
